    Questions

    Who is it for?

    Würth marketing and sales teams who make their own material: social posts, flyers, banners, roll-ups, decks and short films.

    Do I need design software?

    No. Everything runs in the browser: the canvas editor, the slide editor and the AI tools.

    How does the AI stay on brand?

    It works with the Würth corporate design rules built in, takes the logo and claim from the Library instead of drawing them, and uses only the facts you give it. Published work is reviewed by people.

    What does the AI cost me?

    Every account has a monthly credit allowance, and each country has a shared pool. You see your balance before you generate.
